name: Holger Regenbrecht
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Holger Regenbrecht as an author of “An augmented-reality sand-based 3D terrain interface”.
Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Holger Regenbrecht as an author of “A tangible interface for land development teaching”.
